title: Every Lesson Covered, but by Whom? Code and data for fair teacher substitution in high schools
description: Code, instances and raw results for the paper 'Every Lesson Covered, but by Whom? Fair Teacher Substitution in High Schools with Constraint Programming'. Includes a CP-SAT model for high-school timetables with parallel group blocks, three methods for the daily assignment of substitute teachers, absence scenarios calibrated on open data from England and adapted to Romanian rules, and a Streamlit application.
